name: services/mobility/search_course

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: Query that course matching that will be returned

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: Language that name will be matched

arguments.name: num
arguments.description: Number of items that will be returned

arguments.name: mobility_id
arguments.description: Mobility for what ECTS will be calculated

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • items - a list of matching courses. The length of this list is limited to num items. You can access further results by specifing the start parameter.

    Each item on this list is a dictionary of following fields

    • id - ID of the courseid
    • name - langdict with name of the course
    • ects_credits - Number of ects credits that student passing course receive.

    • match - a string with matching fragments highlighted with HTML <b> tag. Language used in construction of this string may vary - you may not assume it will always be your preferred language. It also may include the course ID (if we think it's relevant).

  • next_page - boolean, indicates if there is a next page of results for this query.
